mapper.select: select t.id, t.category, t.subject_type as subjectType, t.subject_id as subjectId, t.status, ( select m.body from cm_inbox_messages m where m.thread_id = t.id order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc limit 1 ) as lastMessage, ( select m.created_at from cm_inbox_messages m where m.thread_id = t.id order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc limit 1 ) as lastMessageAt, case when ( select max(m.created_at) from cm_inbox_messages m where m.thread_id = t.id ) > coalesce(( select r.last_read_at from cm_inbox_reads r where r.thread_id = t.id and r.user_id = t.user_id limit 1 ), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') then true else false end as unread, t.created_at as createdAt, t.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_inbox_threads t where t.user_id = #{userId} order by coalesce(( select max(m.created_at) from cm_inbox_messages m where m.thread_id = t.id ), t.updated_at) desc, t.id desc

select id, user_id as userId, category, subject_type as subjectType, subject_id as subjectId, status, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_inbox_threads where id = #{threadId} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1
select thread_id as threadId, last_read_at as lastReadAt from cm_inbox_reads where thread_id = #{threadId} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_messages ( id, thread_id, sender_type, sender_user_id, message_type, body, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{threadId}, 'user', #{userId}, 'text', #{body}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_threads set updated_at = now() where id = #{threadId}
